title: Fat Harvesting Protocol for Enhanced Stem Cell Viability
author: Pimenta, Ruan
materials: MTT (3-(4,5-dimethylthiazol-2-yl)-2,5-diphenyl tetrazolium bromide) (Sigma-Aldrich, Burlington, USA) was solubilized in PBS at 5 mg/mL and filtered for sterilization and debris removal. The MTT solution was added to a 96-well plate.

After the differentiation assay period, cells were stained to confirm the differentiation efficiency, and a specific dye was used for each lineage. For adipogenic differentiation, oil red O (Sigma-Aldrich, Burlington, USA) was used; for chondrogenic differentiation, alcian blue (Inlab, São Paulo, Brazil) and for osteogenic differentiation, alizarin red (Sigma-Aldrich, Burlington, USA) was used. The plates were then photographed using the PrimeCam 12 ProS equipment (Prime LifeScience, Boca Raton, USA).

steps.title: Verify patient eligibility
steps.instruction: Confirm that each participant has no active systemic or local infection, no uncontrolled systemic disease, and no allergy to any component of the liposuction procedure.

steps.title: Prepare patient for liposuction
steps.instruction: Place the participant in dorsal decubitus, induce general anesthesia, and perform antisepsis with chlorhexidine 0.3% (Rioquímica, São José do Rio Preto, Brazil).

substeps.instruction: Make a 5 mm incision at the umbilicus and the superior iliac crest using a number 15 scalpel.
Insert a 4 mm multiperforated cannula into the adipose tissue; do not inject any substance into the subcutaneous compartment.

steps.title: Collect adipose tissue
steps.instruction: Using Coleman's technique, aspirate adipose tissue from the abdominal region into ten 10 mL Luer‑lock syringes (BD, São Paulo, Brazil) per participant, yielding 100 mL per participant.

steps.title: Mix and aliquot samples
steps.instruction: Combine the three participants’ fat samples into a single pool, let the pooled fat decant for 15 min, then divide into 10 mL aliquots for the four downstream analyses.

steps.title: Analysis 1 – Wash fat
steps.instruction: Separate and wash fat fractions to evaluate saline versus Ringer lactate washing.

substeps.instruction: Place each 10 mL syringe upright at room temperature for 30 min (gravity separation).
Discard the liquid phase at the bottom of each syringe.
Fragment the remaining fat with tweezers and scissors.
Obtain the stromal fraction by centrifugation at 1000 rpm for 3 min.
Group A (saline): wash three times with 0.9 % saline solution (Cristália, São Paulo, Brazil).
Group B (Ringer lactate): wash three times with Ringer lactate (Isofarma, Fortaleza, Brazil).
Homogenize each washed sample and proceed to MTT analysis (see step 8).

steps.title: Analysis 2 – Add anesthetic additives
steps.instruction: Test the effect of common anesthetic/vasoconstrictor additives on fat viability.

substeps.instruction: Take 5 mL of pooled fat, fragment to ~1 mm pieces with tweezers/scissors.
Prepare four additive groups plus a control:
• Lidocaine group: add 2 % lidocaine (0.007 mg) (Cristália) and incubate 1 h.
• Ropivacaine group: add 2 % ropivacaine (0.07 mg) (Cristália) and incubate 1 h.
• Epinephrine group: add epinephrine 1:1000 (0.01 mg) (Blau) and incubate 1 h.
• Sodium bicarbonate group: add sodium bicarbonate 0.04 mg (8.4 %) (Samtec) and incubate 1 h.
• Control group: no additive, incubate 1 h under identical conditions.
After incubation, homogenize each aliquot and proceed to MTT analysis (step 8).

steps.title: Analysis 3 – Fractioning passes
steps.instruction: Assess the impact of the number of Luer‑to‑Luer transfers on cell viability.

substeps.instruction: Divide ten 10 mL syringes into four groups (each in triplicate, 5 mL per vial):
• Control (no transfer).
• 10 transfers using a 2.4 mm Luer‑to‑Luer device (Tulip Medical, San Diego, USA).
• 20 transfers using the same device.
• 30 transfers using the same device.
After the designated number of transfers, homogenize each sample and proceed to MTT analysis (step 8).

steps.title: Prepare and run MTT assay
steps.instruction: Quantify cell viability for all experimental conditions.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve MTT (3‑(4,5‑dimethylthiazol‑2‑yl)‑2,5‑diphenyl tetrazolium bromide) (Sigma‑Aldrich, Burlington, USA) in PBS to a concentration of 5 mg/mL and filter‑sterilize.
Add 100 µL of the MTT solution to each well of a 96‑well plate.
Add the homogenized fat samples (four experiments in triplicate for washing; three experiments in triplicate for anesthetic and fractioning) to the corresponding wells.
Incubate the plate at 37 °C for 4 h.
Add acid‑isopropanol solution (100 µL isopropanol : ≈1 µL 0.04 N HCl) to each well and mix thoroughly to dissolve the formazan crystals.
Allow the mixture to rest at room temperature until crystals are fully dissolved.
Read absorbance at 560 nm within 1 h using a SpectraMax 340PC384 microplate reader (Molecular Devices, San Jose, USA).

steps.title: Select optimal conditions
steps.instruction: Based on the MTT results, choose the best washing solution, anesthetic additive, and number of Luer‑to‑Luer passages for downstream culture.

steps.title: Enzymatic digestion of selected fat
steps.instruction: Digest 10 mL of fat (prepared with the optimal conditions) to obtain a stromal vascular fraction.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the fat to a conical tube and add 4 mL of trypsin/0.25 % EDTA.
Place the tube in a 37 °C water bath and agitate every 5 min for a total of 20 min.
Inactivate trypsin by adding 10 mL of DMEM (Gibco) supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS) and 1 % penicillin/streptomycin.

steps.title: Centrifuge and wash cell pellet
steps.instruction: Isolate and clean the cell pellet after digestion.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1800 rpm for 5 min at 20 °C.
Remove supernatant with a Pasteur pipette and wash the pellet with 10 mL of DMEM.
Centrifuge again under the same conditions, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of DMEM.

steps.title: Assess initial viability and seed culture
steps.instruction: Determine cell viability and establish the primary culture.

substeps.instruction: Take 10 µL of the suspension, mix with 0.4 % Trypan blue, and count viable cells in a Neubauer chamber.
Adjust the cell suspension to a final volume of 5 mL.
Transfer to a 25 cm² culture flask and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified atmosphere.

steps.title: Expand cells to passage 4
steps.instruction: Propagate the adipose‑derived stromal cells (ADSC) up to the fourth passage.

substeps.instruction: When confluence reaches ≥80 %, detach cells with trypsin/EDTA 0.25 % for 2 min at 37 °C.
Neutralize trypsin with DMEM +10 % FBS, centrifuge at 1800 rpm for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend.
Count cells and adjust concentration to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL.
Repeat the detachment, neutralization, centrifugation, and reseeding steps until the fourth passage is reached.

steps.title: Seed cells for differentiation
steps.instruction: Plate ADSC for adipogenic, chondrogenic, and osteogenic differentiation assays.

substeps.instruction: Seed 1500 cells per well in 6‑well plates.
Culture for 4 days to allow adhesion.
Add the appropriate StemPro™ differentiation kit (Gibco, New York, USA):
• Adipogenesis kit,
• Chondrogenesis kit,
• Osteogenesis kit.
Each kit consists of basal medium (90 %) + differentiation supplements (10 %) plus antibiotic/antimycotic (5 µg/mL).

steps.title: Incubate differentiation cultures
steps.instruction: Maintain differentiation conditions for the required periods.

substeps.instruction: Incubate plates at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Adipogenic and chondrogenic cultures: 14 days; osteogenic cultures: 21 days.
Replace differentiation medium every 3 days.
Use DMEM High Glucose (Gibco) as the control medium.

steps.title: Stain differentiated cells
steps.instruction: Confirm lineage commitment by specific histological stains.

substeps.instruction: Adipogenic: stain with Oil Red O (Sigma‑Aldrich, Burlington, USA).
Chondrogenic: stain with Alcian Blue (Inlab, São Paulo, Brazil).
Osteogenic: stain with Alizarin Red (Sigma‑Aldrich, Burlington, USA).
Photograph stained plates using PrimeCam 12 ProS (Prime LifeScience, Boca Raton, USA).

steps.title: Colony‑forming proliferation assay
steps.instruction: Evaluate the proliferative capacity of the ADSC.

substeps.instruction: Plate 300 cells per well in 6‑well plates.
Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 7–10 days.
Fix colonies with methanol:acetic acid (3:1) for 5 min.
Wash with PBS, add 1 mL of 1 % crystal violet dye, and incubate 30 min.
Wash excess dye, observe and record colony formation.
Optionally re‑stain with the lineage‑specific dyes and photograph using an inverted Nikon microscope equipped with PrimeCam Intervision 12 PRO.
